sample_verbatims.text: I have large pores on my nose and my chin and always despised having them. I received Bye Bye Pores as a #freeproduct from Influenster, in exchange for my review and results. After using the product for only a few days, a visible improvement was noted. I’m now at the 2 week mark and very pleased with the results so far. Although some large pores won’t magically shrink, the product is very effective at exfoliating and removing any trapped dirt inside the pores. hence making them almost disappear. My nose and chin don’t have any black heads any longer, and I noticed the skin more bright and visibly clean. This is [REDACTED_NAME] a product to use on an on-going basis. It is fragrance-free and leaves no residue; you may sometimes feel a very slight tingle, but it means the glycolic acid is doing its job. I used it nighty.

sample_verbatims.text: This must be the most underrated skincare product on the planet. No one talks about this! But EUK 134 works faster and more effectively than anything else I’ve tried in reducing redness and hyperpigmentation. Better yet, I’ve never had any kind of bad reaction to it. It’s warm when it goes on, but that subsides. On my skin, it has been superior to Vitamin C and AHAs when it comes to immediate effect—I still use the others because research shows how important they are long-term. I saw real results within *a week,* significant enough that friends commented. I am [REDACTED_NAME] a lot of people steer clear of this one also because it has so many conflicts, but it *does* work with retinoids. Depending on your own skin type, it would go well over or under your retinoid. It is such a powerful antioxidant that I also like wearing it alone in the daytime under my SPF. If I am [REDACTED_NAME], this is [REDACTED_NAME] ingredient in Estée Lauder’s iconic Advanced Night Repair. This, as you can see, is $10. And it is the only skincare (other than SPF) that I absolutely cannot do without.

sample_verbatims.text: I have been looking for a high quality, clean, and affordable face cleanser for oily skin for about 3 months now. I think I finally found one I love. My main concern with face washes designed for oily skin is how tight they cause my face to become before applying a moisturizer. This product DOES NOT do that for me! I find that it does what a face wash should do, but nothing overly special, which is why I gave it 4 stars. The scent reminded my of a clean chlorinated pool, and the “natural” scent commonly found in “clean” products was not nasty and unbearable, and the smell did not stay behind on the skin, which is something I HATE. Over all, great for oily skin
